name: solide-drivers
description: Board-support package for the Solide S3 device (ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8): e-paper (fast 2-colour + 3-colour), WS2812B LED ring with agent-status segmentation, I2S speaker + I2S MEMS mic audio, SD storage, NVS+SD persistent memory, and an EC11 encoder + menu FSM. Hardware-only, documented for humans and agents, host- and device-tested.
keywords: esp32-s3, bsp, e-paper, gxepd2, ws2812, neopixel, i2s, inmp441, sd, encoder
